summary: All 13 books checked ayah by ayah; Arabic, TR and EN agree on every sampled entry. No translation fixes needed. One source defect: nahhas-irab:3-3 holds a repeated verse-3 heading and the 66:4 comment (no own 66:4 entry). Zajjaj:1-1 and mekki-muskil:6-6 legitimately cover neighbouring ayahs. All low flags are orthographic artifacts. Gaps reported for 7 books.
